notes: Expansion paired with biology-replace-0012 (RBox revision: 'is a mutualist of' loses symmetry and becomes asymmetric). The paired revision flips symmetry of a real relation; this insert gives the made-up relation marrow_paired_with symmetry, with real organisms in the instances. RELATIONS.md still reads 'insert 0016 makes it symmetric' for this relation: the property is the same, only the record id moved. The instance pairs are eater and eaten (panda and bamboo, whale and krill), not the symbiotic partners of the revision, so no mutual reading comes from the organisms. A symmetry insert has no honest no instance, so the balance (Rule 9) comes from phrasing: the direct question asks about asymmetry (no), the first instance and its cross-lingual versions ask whether the reverse is denied (no), the second instance asks whether the reverse follows (yes). Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
